_comment: On-screen regions, as fractions of frame width/height: [x1, y1, x2, y2]. These are PLACEHOLDERS for a portrait phone recording and must be tuned to your video. Run `python tools/inspect_frame.py input/<video> --grid`, read the percentages off the grid, then copy this file to data/layout.json and edit.
_hand_comment: The strip holding your four cards, along the bottom.
_towers_comment: Each enemy health bar, tight to the bar itself: just the coloured strip, no border, no number. Left and right are the princess towers, king is the middle one at the top.
_colour_comment: HSV bounds for the enemy bar colour. OpenCV hue runs 0-179, so red needs two ranges, one at each end. Widen the saturation/value floors if bars read as empty.
